interpretation_limits: Command-pair validation cells have only two examples. They locate observed failures and are not reliable stand-alone generalization estimates.
Error behavior matches are nonexclusive; several transformations can coincide on a repeated-digit input. A matching wrong answer does not identify the internal causal mechanism.

Qualification gains use raw unprivileged prompts. Full-TRAIN matched-prompt gains separately isolate training from rules and demonstrations supplied in context. Fresh matched-privileged primitive validation is measured by separate chain qualification.
Teacher-forced scores are aggregated from archived measurements; this CPU audit does not rerun the model or remeasure probabilities.
Literal-position diagnostics preserve the original character-offset definition even for malformed outputs; strict formatted-position counts are additionally separate and never alter qualification.
All arms and programs are reported. These results do not select a recipe or authorize additional optimization.
source_instruction: Tokenizer pieces read directly from original Qwen3.5-4B tokenizer.json on NFS; escaped spaces/newlines decoded via its ByteLevel declaration.
